method: No-vig sportsbook anchor (RG.org Oct 25 morning snapshot of FD/DK/FAN/BR/LBMD, TheSpread, Covers), then RESEARCH.md stats (moves capped at 4 points). Polymarket prices from polymarket.com/sports/nfl/games (~15:00Z, PIT-NO live in Q2) and NBA team pages; KC-SEA cross-checked against defirate's Polymarket US/Kalshi table. The gamma API and direct polymarket.com URLs were not approved for this run, so asks are page prices (not verified order-book asks), bids are ask-1c, liquidity unknown (null). Verified slugs: nfl-gb-det-2026-10-25-spread-home-3pt5, nba-orl-nyk-2026-10-25, nba-tor-min-2026-10-25; others follow the usual pattern and are NOT verified.

legs.label: NFL: Packers +3.5 at Lions
legs.why: Anchor (Oct 25 morning, 5 books): GB +3.5 -112/-108 FD, -115/-105 DK, -114/-108 BR, -118/-105 LBMD => GB +3.5 50.4-51.4% no-vig (~51%); ML DET -179 to -196 / GB +150 to +160 => GB ~37.7%. Line went DET -3 open -> -4 midweek -> back to -3.5 Sunday. Stats: GB 4-2, 3 straight wins, allowed 14/7/13 pts last 3; Love healthy; Jacobs makes season debut; Parsons (ACL) and LB Franklin OUT; Banks/St-Juste Q. DET 3-2, 32.8 ppg (tied 1st), Goff 12 TD/0 INT, defense near bottom in points allowed; Branch and Mays practiced fully (expected back); DET off bye. Indoors, weather n/a. EPA n/a this run. Matchup lean GB (DET pass D) offset by DET rest + healthy secondary: no move. 51% vs page ask 49c = +2c, below the 3c bar.

legs.label: NFL: Packers-Lions Under 54.5
legs.why: Anchor: total 54.5, Over -115/Under -105 at FD and DK, -114/-105 LBMD, -109/-112 BR (FAN 55) => Under 48.9-50.4% (~49%). Opened ~53.5, peaked 55.5 midweek. Stats: every DET game has gone over with 55+ combined; GB games 4-2 to the under and GB allowed <=14 in 3 straight; GB adds Jacobs (more run, slower clock). Dome, no weather. Trends conflict: no move. 49% vs 47c = +2c, below bar. Slug follows the usual pattern (unverified).

legs.label: NFL SNF: Chiefs to win at Seahawks
legs.why: Anchor: SEA -154/KC +130 FD (41.8% KC no-vig), -143/+120 DK (43.6%), -156/+130 FAN, -143/+118 BR => KC ~42.5%. Polymarket US 41.5c, Kalshi 42c (defirate). Stats: KC 5-0 (22-6 over LAC; Mahomes 23/30 272y 0 TD 1 INT); SEA 3-3, lost 17-14 OT at DEN on TNF (Darnold 27/51, 2 INT) so SEA has 10 days rest. KC injuries: WR Rashee Rice OUT, T Jaylon Moore OUT (concussion), LT Josh Simmons IR, WR Thornton IR, CB Sneed Q (did not travel) => thin WR room and OL vs Seattle's front; SEA: Charbonnet OUT, LBs Surratt/Thomas OUT, Nwosu/Emmanwori expected to play. Kalshi shows SEA up 6 points this week (KC news priced). Total 42.5 all books. No move. +0.5c.

legs.label: NFL SNF: Chiefs +2.5 at Seahawks
legs.why: Anchor: books split SEA -3 (-105; FD/FAN/DK) and SEA -2.5 (-118/-122; BR/LBMD). KC +2.5 no-vig 48.5% (BR) and 47.4% (LBMD); from KC +3 -115 (51.1% ex-push, ~9% push on 3) ~46.5%. Consensus ~47.5%. Polymarket US 'Seahawks by 3+' 53.5c (KC +2.5 ~46.5c). Same injury/rest notes as kc-ml (KC OL and WR depth thin; SEA 10 days rest). No move. +0.5c.

legs.why: Anchor: CIN -3 (-105)/BAL +3 (-115) at FAN/DK/BR, CIN -2.5 -120/BAL +2.5 -102 FD, -122/+100 LBMD => BAL +2.5 ~47.5-48%; ML CIN -147 to -156 => BAL ~42%.
